narrative.intro: OptumServe Health Services has $85.6M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. OptumServe Health Services won 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $42.8M. OptumServe Health Services obligations are down 95.5% year over year. OptumServe Health Services received most FY2027 to date spending from the Department of Veterans Affairs, which obligated $83.4M. OptumServe Health Services also received $2.2M from the Department of Health and Human Services. OptumServe Health Services work in FY2027 to date is concentrated in Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists), which accounted for $83.4M, and All Other Outpatient Care Centers, which accounted for $2.2M. OptumServe Health Services historical annual obligations show large variation: FY22 obligations were $874M, FY23 obligations were $711M, FY24 obligations were $1.6B, FY25 obligations were $2.5B, and FY26 obligations were $1.9B. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).

sections.heading: Who are the top buyers in FY2027 to date?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the top buyer with $83.4M in obligations. The Department of Health and Human Services is the second buyer with $2.2M in obligations. No other agencies are listed in the top-buyers table for FY2027 to date.

sections.heading: What are the primary markets for FY2027 to date?
sections.body: Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is the largest market with $83.4M in obligations. All Other Outpatient Care Centers is the second market with $2.2M in obligations. Those two NAICS markets together account for the full FY2027 to date obligations shown.

faq.q: How much does OptumServe Health Services make from federal contracts?

faq.q: Which agencies buy from OptumServe Health Services?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs and the Department of Health and Human Services buy from OptumServe Health Services in FY2027 to date. The Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $83.4M and the Department of Health and Human Services obligated $2.2M.

faq.q: What does OptumServe Health Services sell to the government?
faq.a: OptumServe Health Services sells physician-office and outpatient care services to the government. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) accounted for $83.4M and All Other Outpatient Care Centers accounted for $2.2M in FY2027 to date.
